scope: Fixed public Avaota/WalnutPi source/build trees, selected object-source closure, and three actual official user-space package payloads. Absence claims limited to inspected snapshots. No compilation, installation, module loading or hardware execution.

package_integrity.method: Package SHA256/length matched against fixed official GitHub Packages indices
package_integrity.transport: Official HTTP apt bytes used after HTTPS failure; no installation/execution

scope_notes: No .ko suffix found in reviewed public source snapshots is not proof that every downstream image has no extra binary-only modules.
Public source visibility, license, successful rebuild, and runtime acceptance are separate.
Prebuilt Mesa/FFmpeg/glibc are not classified closed merely because an ELF is shipped.

walnut.scope: Path inventory is complete for inspected trees; not every driver or configuration was compiled or line-reviewed.
